title: ORPA: Online Residual Policy Adaptation for Robot Manipulation Control with Human Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.17323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic manipulation policies trained via imitation learning, such as Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), can achieve strong performance under ideal conditions but often remain sensitive to small execution errors and distribution shifts. Correcting these failures typically requires dataset aggregation and full-policy retraining, which is computationally expensive and unsuitable for real-time deployment. In this work, we propose Online Residual Policy Adaptation (ORPA), a framework that enables immediate, feedback-driven correction of robot actions without modifying the underlying policy parameters. ORPA augments a pretrained control policy with a lightweight, feedback-conditioned module that predicts residual adjustments directly in joint space, allowing the system to adapt its behavior at runtime. translated_title: ORPA：基于人类反馈的机器人操作控制在线残差策略自适应
translated_abstract: 通过模仿学习训练的操作策略，如基于Transformer的动作分块（ACT），在理想条件下能表现出强大性能，但通常对小执行误差和分布偏移敏感。纠正这些失败通常需要数据集聚合和全策略重新训练，这在计算上代价高昂且不适合实时部署。在本工作中，我们提出在线残差策略自适应（ORPA），一个无需修改底层策略参数即可实现即时、反馈驱动的机器人动作纠正框架。ORPA通过一个轻量级的、基于反馈的模块增强预训练控制策略，该模块直接在关节空间中预测残差调整，使系统能在运行时适应其行为。我们在ALOHA平台上对一组精度敏感的操作任务评估了ORPA，证明了成功率的提升。
tldr: 本文提出ORPA框架，通过轻量级反馈条件模块在关节空间中实时预测残差调整，无需重新训练即可纠正预训练操作策略的误差，从而提升精度敏感任务的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ORPA, a framework that uses a lightweight feedback-conditioned module to predict residual adjustments in joint space in real-time, correcting errors of pretrained manipulation policies without retraining, thereby improving performance on precision-sensitive tasks.
